Advertisement
Applications are invited along with bio-data and attested copies of the certificates of qualification, experience,
etc. for positions of Junior Research Fellow and Project Interns in University Institute of Engineering and
Technology (UIET), Panjab University, Chandigarh under the project titled “Development of framework/utility
for archival, processing, visualization & classification of seismic signal data for detection of snow avalanche
events” sanctioned by DGRE, Chandigarh.
 The position of Junior Research Fellow is for a period of one year and likely to be extended up to
another 12 months OR coterminous with project, depending upon the satisfactory performance of the
candidate.
 The position of Project Intern is for a period of 06 months and likely to be extended up to another 18
months OR coterminous with project, depending upon the satisfactory performance of the candidate.
The incumbents are also expected to work on Saturdays/Sundays and may be on holidays also for any project
exigency. The interested candidates need to apply online at Google form link
https://forms.gle/fsoKx6qDwDUvhgjW6. The candidates should apply within 20 days from the date of
advertisement.
Junior Research Fellow: 01
Essential Qualifications:
“First class throughout with M.E / M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering / Information
Technology with GATE / UGC NET Qualified and B.E / B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering /
Information Technology”.
OR
“B.E / B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering / Information Technology with 75% marks and
valid GATE score”.
Desirable: Knowledge of Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence/Signal Processing and willing to
pursue Ph.D. in CSE/IT.
Emoluments per month: Rs. 35,000/-
Project Intern: 02
Essential Qualifications:
“2nd year students of B.E./B.Tech of Computer Science and Engineering / Information Technology”.
Desirable: Knowledge of Machine Learning/Signal Processing and Web Development
Emoluments per month: Rs. 10,000/-
The date and venue of the interview will be conveyed to the eligible candidates through email or phone. No
separate call letters would be issued for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending
the interview.
Dr. Neelam Goel
PI and Assistant Professor, IT
UIET, Panjab University, Chandigarh
